1.explanation:
1. ContentSwitcher/index.js & ContentSwitcher/ContentSwitcher.js: the core component logic and styles where the new `light` prop must be introduced and propagated.  
2. ContentSwitcher/ContentSwitcher.stories.js: shows the existing variants and will need a new story for the `light` variant to verify visual correctness.  
3. TextInput/README.md, TextInput/TextInput.js & TextInput/TextInput.stories.js: reference implementation of a `light` prop. Reviewing how TextInput applies `light` styling and tokens will guide adding a similar variant to ContentSwitcher.
1.bug_scenario: The screenshot shows the ContentSwitcher component rendered on a dark (ui-01) background. The unselected segment (“By account”) has dark text on a dark background and is nearly invisible, and the selected segment (“By reviewer”) uses the default light background pill which doesn’t have sufficient contrast or a distinct border on this dark surface. Visually, the pill background, container background, and label text styling need a “light” variant or adjusted tokens so that both selected and unselected states are legible on dark surfaces.
